findings: 200-Stamina Strike Evasive from the TP Medal Shop. The user teleports in front of the opponent and lands a single punch that knocks the opponent away; current skill-specific evidence reports about 5% damage. If used after a prior knockback, the teleport can move the user ahead of the opponent toward their landing point before the punch. Exact teleport timing, interception distance, and frame data remain unresolved.
boundaries: Evidence-backed mechanics only; exact frame timing, hidden thresholds, reward probabilities, and patch-independent balance values remain unresolved where not directly established.
